messages:
Priya: Heads-up: Orion partner wants a joint perf/W mini-run next Thurs. Scope: 4-node rack, two BIOS profiles, and kernel ipc tuning. Can we confirm lab access window and who owns power ingest?

Ethan: I can do power ingest. Plan to sample at 1s and push to s3://telemetry/orion/ with rack tags.

Vera: Partner will provide their kernel patchset (diff + instructions). They want us to run baseline (stock) then patched. We need a short smoke script and canonical CSV header.

Priya: Draft smoke checklist: unpack driver/patch, apply kernel if requested, reboot, set BIOS=orion-opt, set fan=eco for smoke, run harness 2x (seq 256,512) 5m each, collect prom + pdu.

Ethan: I'll prepare converter: `pdu_to_canon.py` and a small lambda to verify checksums on upload.

Vera: Partner asks for kernel config: CONFIG_SCHED_DEBUG=off, disable cpuidle on these nodes. I'll add to runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: confirm ORION lab access and SSH jump creds by 2026-04-02T15:00Z.

Priya: Who's on-call for day-of? Need ops + partner eng.

Ethan: I'll be on-call. Also will run staging canary 24h earlier to validate pdu pipeline.

Vera: I'll own the baseline vs patched labels in results and tag runs with driver_version/kernel_sha.

Priya: Great. Action items: Ethan - pdu pipeline + canary; Vera - runbook + kernel flags; Priya - calendar + partner liaisons. Target: finish by EOD Tue.

Ethan: ACK.

Vera: ACK.
